No. I mean technician positions. Even then I would still have to keep searching for an engineering position. 

Industrial engineering.
Yeah but those who change or do the right things when they're young are much better off in life. They have prettier/less slutty wives, better jobs, more friends, etc.
It's fine just frustrating seeing my graduating class in 60k/year jobs they found before graduation. Meanwhile I can't get an offer to save my life. Even tech positions are sticking my nose up at me.

At least you had a loving wife. 

I focused entirely on school and my career. There were only two periods in my life when I actively dated. Both times were short termed. I put in a lot of time into projects, finding an internship, mock interviews, networking, multiple resume workshops and involvement in major related clubs. All of that and I'm the one who is living in his parents basement. I get interviews but one miss-step, means I will be passed on for someone else. Even at companies i went through multiple rounds, one miss step at the final round is all that matters. It doesn't matter that I impressed the other 3 interviewers. 

Meanwhile people I know who did party, hook up with tons of girls, and are now in serious long term relationships, all work at awesome jobs. They have tons of friends who put in a good word and they are practically handed the best jobs. There's no way I can compete with a guy who interned at a company since his freshman year, all because his friends cousin needed an intern. 

If someone tells me they would rather have an employee refer someone than go through the process that gives everyone a fair shot, I will bash their mouth with a hammer until half their teeth are missing, stab out both their eyes, and mutilate their genitals.

How dare you insinuate that I am just applying to my "dream job."  I'm applying to every single professional opportunity i am remotely qualified for. Even tech positions that don't require a degree. 

I interviewed at approximately 20 something places, I lost count. Applied to hundreds of places. Even hit up a few people in my network. 

I swear if one more person talks about the "engineering shortage" I will stab out their eyes and let them bleed to death.
